objective: Classify minimal fixed-center Hall cores by cycle rank; prove the unique no-four-cycle defect-two structure and a single-center-exchange barrier with an explicit positive root instance.

atomic_claims.text: A minimal deficient support of an eligible center set has defect d in {1,2} and connected incidence graph with cycle rank d+1-r, where r counts support vertices adjacent to centers.
In a cubic graph without four-cycles, every minimal defect-two incidence graph is the one-subdivision of K4; girth at least seven therefore excludes defect two.

For an edgeless center set, every minimal defect-one core after private-leaf deletion is a theta or loose handcuff; with four centers and no four-cycle the two theta length types are (2,4,4) and (3,3,3).
An edgeless proposed center set with a minimal defect-two support cannot be repaired to a P3-factor center set by any single center exchange.
The displayed eighteen-vertex simple cubic 3-connected girth-five graph has such a bad center set and an explicit factor exactly two center exchanges away.

assumptions: The initial proposed center set has induced maximum degree at most one.
The theta and one-exchange claims additionally assume the initial center set contains no edge.
No-four-cycle and girth hypotheses are stated only where used.
Selected P3 subgraphs need not be induced; finite-graph-basic and finite-combinatorics are the allowed axioms.
risks: These are fixed-center obstruction results, not a universal choice of centers or root closure.
The eighteen-vertex example has a positive P3-factor and is not a root counterexample.
The cyclic-connectivity-five observation depends on replaying a finite cut histogram; the main host properties have separate hand proofs.
One graph was checked, not a census of all eighteen-vertex graphs.
The local checker is not included in this proof-only packet and is not a registered verifier.
The protected legacy DAG dependency still needs trusted repair; no records were changed.
The previously blocked ROOT-R01 executable upload is not retried or repackaged.

failed_route_proposal.blocker: A minimal defect-two support prevents every single center exchange from repairing an initially edgeless center set. The explicit eighteen-vertex host has a different positive factor at exchange distance exactly two. Only the one-step repair shortcut fails.
